name: design-to-code
description: Root orchestration package for the design-to-code docker stack

scripts.setup: yarn util:install && yarn util:prepare-workspace && yarn start
scripts.start: yarn util:prepare-workspace && yarn stop && yarn start:dev
scripts.stop: if [ -f docker-compose.yaml ]; then docker compose down --remove-orphans --volumes; fi && docker network prune -f
scripts.compose:build: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local build app relay nginx cache && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local build
scripts.start:dev: yarn start:reverse-proxy && ./docker-compose-generator.sh && yarn compose:build && yarn compose:up && yarn util:is-ready
scripts.start:prod: yarn start:reverse-proxy && ./docker-compose-generator.sh --prod && yarn compose:build && yarn compose:up && yarn util:is-ready
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f app relay nginx cache
